This is my biggest plot and maize is what feeds my family, so I must do my best on it. I usually manage to get the FISP coupon through the village — one bag of NPK and one bag of urea — and I also put some kraal manure from my neighbor before planting. I will use the hybrid seed from the coupon because on 1.44 hectares the local seed gives me too little. I cannot afford to spray, and we have no river or pump here, so we wait for the rains. For weeding I will work with my daughter and call some ganyu for a few days when the weeds come fast after the first rains.
